name: Namaste Restaurant Manager
description: Complete restaurant management app — menu display, online ordering, table reservations, and delivery tracking for Wix sites.

widgets.name: Restaurant Menu
widgets.description: Displays the restaurant menu with categories, dietary filters, and responsive layouts.

widgets.name: Online Ordering
widgets.description: Allows customers to place orders for delivery, pickup, or dine-in.

widgets.name: Table Reservations
widgets.description: Lets customers book tables with date, time, and party size selection.

widgets.name: Delivery Zone & Tracking
widgets.description: Shows delivery zones, calculates fees, and tracks order delivery status.

panels.name: Restaurant Settings
panels.description: Configure restaurant details, hours, delivery zones, and widget appearance.

dashboardPages.name: Orders
dashboardPages.description: Manage incoming orders and update their status.

dashboardPages.name: Analytics
dashboardPages.description: Revenue charts, popular items, and customer insights.
